chunks: Talḥah ibn Zayd narrated from al-Ṣādiq, from his father, peace be upon them.
Indeed, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله ruled in favor of shuf'ah so long as it had not been apportioned, meaning divided.

key_terms.بِالشُّفْعَةِ: regarding the right of pre-emption in jointly held property

ai.seo_question: When does the right of shuf'ah apply according to the hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله regarding shuf'ah, the right of pre-emption. It indicates that this right remains in effect so long as the shared property has not yet been divided.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3367 - Talhah ibn Zayd narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), peace be upon them:
"Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) ruled in favor of preemption (shufah) as long as the property had not been inherited, meaning divided."
